title: oldenlandia pruinosa
intro: Oldenlandia pruinosa, commonly known as Bhringaraj or Eclipta, is a perennial herb native to Asia and India. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving skin and hair health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia pruinosa include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Oldenlandia pruinosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
